$comment: AXIOM parameter registry — generated by contracts/build_registry.py; consumed by the config loader (AX-13 §6).

venue.base_url.note: structural API entry point; measurable venue facts live in venue_profile.json

venue.f_safe.note: fraction of the venue rate limit the system may use (AX-02 §7.1)

venue.recv_window_ms.note: recvWindow actually sent; venue default documented as 5000 [V-DOC]

data.repair_trade_history_bars.note: REST trades are limited to 60 records [V-DOC]

data.health_gate_ids.note: gates that can move an instrument to FAIL

universe.max_instruments.note: candidate set is always the full eligible venue set; this caps what may be traded

features.availability_floor.note: below ⇒ feature demoted to zero weight

forecast.p_net_min.note: minimum calibrated probability of positive net return

forecast.weight_clip.note: max weight of one model in the combination

forecast.edge_z.note: z for the lower bound of the edge

risk.risk_fraction.note: R per trade as a fraction of equity

risk.d_max.note: drawdown at which the system hard de-risks

risk.daily_loss_cap.note: stop new risk for the UTC day

risk.max_exit_minutes.note: time to exit the position at MQV

risk.kelly_lcb_factor.note: lower confidence bound on the Kelly size

risk.q_tail.note: tail quantile for the gap term

risk.tail_multiplier_cap.note: maximum gap loss as a multiple of R

execution.tick_slack.note: ticks beyond the touch when crossing

execution.unprotected_flatten_r.note: flatten if unprotected and notional > this

execution.opportunity_cost_allowance.note: max share of gross edge lost to non-execution

execution.emergency_offset_spreads.note: emergency IOC offset when market orders are forbidden

cost.uncertainty_m.note: m_c on σ_cost in the gate

cost.edge_z.note: z_g on σ_model in the gate

cost.sessions_above_band.note: K5 after this many consecutive sessions

cost.funding_defer_ratio.note: defer entry if funding > this share of edge

governor.escalation_minutes.note: SEV-1 repeat / SEV-2 ack / SEV-2 action

ops.tick_s.note: decision cadence (bar-aligned); equals the smallest horizon bar length

ops.notify_destination_ref.note: identifier resolved from the secret store; never a literal in this file

ops.topology.note: A single-node | B edge+compute | C server

ops.crash_loop_restarts.note: restarts within the window that force OFF

ops.param_cooloff_minutes.note: cooling-off before a risk-parameter change applies

ops.max_manual_change_r.note: a manual action may not exceed this risk

security.forbidden_permissions.note: must be impossible on the API key

tests.coverage_floor_pct.note: branch coverage floor on decision-critical packages

tests.mutation_per_module.note: surviving mutants per module fail the build

forecast.sharpness_floor.note: sharpness is measured; the floor is set by calibration (AX-06 §3.3)

features.kyle_window_trades.note: Kyle-lambda window (used by the cost model too)

features.xs_min_breadth.note: minimum cross-sectional breadth for any XS feature

risk.r_floor_rule.note: R is floored so that one step of the smallest tradable size is a legal position (AX-07 §3.2)

risk.surplus_tolerance.note: ties in the surplus ranking (deterministic order)

risk.cluster_cap.note: portfolio cluster cap (allocation stage; distinct from the universe breadth rule P-UNI-007)

risk.participation_cap_mqv.note: same estimator as P-UNI-006, applied at sizing time

risk.per_position_risk_share.note: one position may not consume more than this share of the daily risk budget

risk.leverage_readback_required.note: leverage is set and then read back before any entry (AX-07 §8.4)

governor.reduced_min_p_net.note: new positions in REDUCED require a higher calibrated probability

governor.defensive_close_pct.note: share of gross closed in DEFENSIVE

governor.exec_multiplier_warn.note: m_exec when realised cost is above the band

governor.exec_multiplier_stale.note: m_exec when the cost model is stale

governor.k6_trigger_fraction.note: liquidation distance below this share of the safe requirement triggers K6

governor.status_refusals.note: refusals shown in the status view

governor.gap_loss_multiplier.note: gap-only loss tolerated by the tail budget (same policy as P-RSK-064)

monitoring.min_ic_posterior.note: rolling IC posterior below which a feature is demoted

learning.regime_subsets_same_sign.note: pre-declared regime subsets that must agree

learning.max_cost_gate_refusal_rate.note: above this the candidate is not tradable, not promotable

learning.demotion_psr_floor.note: PSR floor before a one-rung demotion

learning.max_unresolved_sev1_days.note: unresolved SEV-1 older than this moves the system to paper

learning.n_bets_tolerance.note: turnover deviation that forces recomputing R

ops.standalone_days.note: days the live loop must operate without a second machine

ops.status_refusals.note: refusals listed by the status command

ops.paper_soak_days.note: observation window before a live deploy

OI-RISK-01.description: risk appetite per trade (R_fraction; also sets the micro-live fraction)

OI-RISK-02.description: drawdown at which the system must hard de-risk (D_max) and the margin-utilisation cap

OI-RISK-03.description: volatility target, admissible horizons, gross/net/beta caps, turnover cap, edge/cost margins

OI-RISK-05.description: tail multiplier, Kelly fraction, statistical-promotion strictness (PSR/PBO), experiment budget

OI-CAP-01.description: maximum universe size and maximum open positions

OI-CAP-02.description: retention, storage budget, backup interval and locations

OI-OPS-01.description: deployment topology (A/B/C) and the machine that runs the live loop

OI-OPS-02.description: notification channel and destination for SEV-1/2 and digests

OI-OPS-03.description: review cadence, operator heartbeat, cooling-off, manual-action limits, durations of the ladder rungs

OI-GOV-01.description: who may arm, promote, and issue the hard kill (and whether a second person exists)
